genericCallReturnedFunctionParameterDefault.ts(24,5): error TS2345: Argument of type 'string' is not assignable to parameter of type 'number'.


==== genericCallReturnedFunctionParameterDefault.ts (1 errors) ====
    // The function returned from the callback of a generic call has a parameter
    // with a default and no annotation. Once T is inferred, the contextual
    // signature of the returned function is its own signature, but the parameter
    // already has its type (boolean) from the initializer, computed while T was
    // being inferred, so there is no circularity: no TS7022, and 'r()(1)' is an
    // error. (Reduced from open-design ProjectView.tsx, useCallback returning
    // '{ release: (recoverable = false) => ... }'.)
    
    declare function id<T>(callback: T): T;
    
    id(() => {
        return (x = false) => {};
    });
    
    id(() => (y = false) => y);
    
    id(() => {
        return { m(z = false) {} };
    });
    
    const r = id(() => {
        return (w = 0) => {};
    });
    r()("");

!!! error TS2345: Argument of type 'string' is not assignable to parameter of type 'number'.
